execution_lifecycle: Detached scopes inherit the native caller context automatically. Each check has its own log and exit file; no identity selector is manually set.

cases: No-start creates docker.service, then the normal extracted row skips native setup and leaves the fixture CLI context at default
Inherited relative host selection resolves before the research directory change and fails afterward

changes.rootless_setup: Normal installation always delegates to dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install. The pinned upstream preserves an existing unit and still creates/selects its CLI context. No-start skips that command and only registers/reloads the unit. A native setup failure propagates before later row activation.
changes.acceptance_selector: Resolve inherited or saved host selectors with the same realpath operation already used for --host-file, before check dispatch. Assign before export so a canonicalization failure is not hidden. Explicit CLI input retains precedence.
changes.checker: The service audit requires the normal-only setup command and rejects an unguarded call, an extra unguarded call, or the old unit-existence guard.
changes.plan_sync: install-plan.json records the same rootless setup command as install.sh.

focused.command: python3 -B /tmp/install-nostart-safe-tests-velo.py tests.test_install_plan_activation_followup tests.test_install_plan_no_start_ports tests.test_install_plan_review_wave3 tests.test_install_plan_review_wave5 tests.test_install_plan_review_wave6 tests.test_install_plan_review_wave7 tests.test_harbor_currency_contracts tests.test_research_entry

controls: No-start followed by normal setup selects the fixture rootless context without replacing the staged unit
Fresh and repeated normal setup use the native entrypoint
Repeated no-start registers/reloads without native setup or enable/start
Checker rejects missing/extra guards and the old incomplete setup condition
Relative inherited paths, including spaces, survive a research-directory change
Absolute inherited and saved allocations retain their endpoints
An invalid parent path fails before the first check
No selector retains the default gateway

sources.mechanism: Unit reuse and native CLI context creation/selection are distinct setup steps.
Native canonicalization; default mode requires all but the final component to exist. Both the shell and fixture /usr/bin/realpath report0.10.0.
Existing explicit --host-file canonicalization extended to inherited input before directory-changing checks

required_before_commit: Run python3 scripts/validate.py after native evidence registration; final validation and full push-gate outcomes are recorded in the PR body and lane log.
local_execution_boundary: Extracted container-engine/activation helpers with fake package, sudo, systemctl, setup and Docker commands; extracted acceptance option/selector setup and the real offline gateway loader in disposable directories. No full install.sh/accept.sh, native installer, real daemon, model download, credential store or listener activation was run.
native_target_boundary: NativeHorizonNY owns actual Docker setup/context and acceptance checks after this follow-up lands. This source-backed fixture evidence does not establish native Docker/Compose connectivity or target activation success.
